description: Interactive-CO2 experiment with historical volcanic forcing only and other forcings held fixed at 1850's levels, allowing carbon-cycle feedbacks.  For 1850-2021 use CMIP7 historical forcing datasets and for 2022-2035 use the Medium scenario.
branch_information: Initialize from an equilibrated pre-industrial control that has been run with interactive-CO2 at a specific branch time.  Use independent initial conditions for ensemble members.
